headline: Citadel Founder Pledges Historic $3 Billion to Carnegie Mellon
meta_description: Ken Griffin makes transformational $3 billion gift to Carnegie Mellon University, one of the largest donations in higher education history.
summary_short: Citadel founder Ken Griffin has pledged $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University in a landmark gift that will reshape the institution's future.
body:
Citadel founder Ken Griffin has announced a historic $3 billion donation to Carnegie Mellon University, marking one of the largest philanthropic gifts in higher education.

The magnitude of Griffin's contribution underscores the growing momentum of major donors investing in research universities. Carnegie Mellon, a global leader in technology, engineering, and innovation, stands to accelerate its mission through this transformational support.

The donation reflects Griffin's commitment to advancing education and discovery at one of America's premier institutions. For Carnegie Mellon, the gift opens unprecedented possibilities to expand research, attract world-class faculty and students, and strengthen its position at the forefront of higher learning.
quick_facts: Ken Griffin, Citadel founder, pledges $3 billion
Donation goes to Carnegie Mellon University
Among largest gifts in higher education history
